title: React.js Conf 2015 - The complementarity of React and Web Components
summary: Andrew Rota of Wayfair argues at React.js Conf 2015 that React and native Web Components complement each other. He shows how they can be combined for complex web applications.
why: Cited in React versus Web Components threads as a clear picture of how the two interoperate and their challenges.

quote.text: which gives a very clear picture of the current state of React/Web Component interaction, including the challenges associated with it
